title: Samsung Launches Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, Fold 8, and Flip 8 at Galaxy Unpacked
excerpt: The new Fold 8 Ultra features a 200MP camera, 8-inch inner display, and 5,000mAh battery in a 4.1mm-thin body. Samsung also introduced a new wide-format Fold 8 and its slimmest Flip phone yet.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Samsung launched three foldable phones: Z Fold 8 Ultra, Z Fold 8, and Z Flip 8.
  • Z Fold 8 Ultra features a 200MP camera and 8-inch display, priced from £1,899.
  • Z Flip 8 is Samsung's lightest clamshell phone yet, starting at £1,149.
  • All devices include AI features and run on Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5.
  • Preorders are live, with shipping starting August 7.

Three Foldables, Three Form Factors

Samsung expanded its foldable lineup to three distinct devices at its Galaxy Unpacked event in London on July 22, 2026. The company unveiled the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra as its new flagship, a redesigned Galaxy Z Fold 8 with a wider aspect ratio, and the Galaxy Z Flip 8 — its slimmest and lightest clamshell phone yet. It marks the first time Samsung has offered three foldable phones simultaneously.

All three devices run on Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chipset and ship with Android 17 under Samsung's One UI 9 interface. Each comes with 12GB of RAM as standard, rising to 16GB on 1TB storage configurations. Storage options span 256GB, 512GB, and 1TB across the Fold models.

Z Fold 8 Ultra: The Premium Play

The Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra sits at the top of Samsung's mobile lineup. Its 8-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X inner display is roughly equivalent to two 6.5-inch screens side by side, and the phone measures just 4.1mm when unfolded — making it one of the thinnest foldables on the market.

The camera system is a major upgrade: a 200-megapixel main sensor paired with a 50-megapixel ultra-wide lens, along with improved Nightography for low-light performance. Samsung says the 5,000mAh battery delivers up to 27 hours of video playback. The 45W wired fast charging gets the battery to 67% in 30 minutes, and wireless charging runs at 20W.

Samsung introduced a new AI feature called Now Nudge, designed for the multitasking workflows that foldable screens enable. The system monitors what you're doing and suggests contextual actions — if someone sends a calendar invite, for instance, it may prompt you to open Split View with your calendar. Users can dismiss the suggestions if they prefer.

The Z Fold 8 Ultra starts at £1,899 and comes in Violet Shadow, Cream, Graphite, and Violet Green.

Z Fold 8: The Wide-Format Newcomer

The standard Galaxy Z Fold 8 breaks from Samsung's traditional book-style form factor. When closed, it presents a 5.5-inch cover screen in a squatter, more squared shape. Open, it expands to a 7.6-inch display with a 4:3 aspect ratio. Samsung used its new Flex Titanium display technology for added durability, and the screen reaches 3,000 nits of brightness.

The Fold 8 runs the same Snapdragon processor as the Ultra but carries a smaller 4,800mAh battery rated for 26 hours of video playback. Its dual 50-megapixel cameras handle everyday photography. At 201 grams, it is relatively light for a book-fold device.

Industry analyst Paolo Pescatore called the Fold 8 "the clear star of the show," noting its design closely resembles what Apple's long-rumored foldable iPhone could look like when it launches — possibly as soon as September 2026.

The Z Fold 8 starts at £1,699 in Lavender, Cream, Graphite, and Pistachio.

Z Flip 8: Possibly the Last of Its Kind

The Galaxy Z Flip 8 continues Samsung's clamshell line with incremental refinements. At 180 grams and 6.1mm thick, Samsung calls it its lightest and slimmest flip phone to date. The device features a 50-megapixel main camera with a 12-megapixel secondary lens and an improved Flex Window — the outer screen that shows notifications, quick settings, and lets users frame selfies without opening the phone.

The Flip 8 uses an aluminum frame and starts at £1,149 in Pink, Cream, Graphite, and Mint. Reports suggest this could be Samsung's final clamshell foldable, with the company potentially consolidating around book-fold and wide-format designs going forward.

AI Everywhere

Samsung is embedding Google's Gemini AI across the new lineup. Buyers get a free six-month trial of Google AI Pro with any of the three foldables. The integration extends beyond Now Nudge to broader Galaxy AI features including improved translation, writing assistance, and photo editing capabilities that leverage the larger screen real estate foldable phones provide.

"Google and especially Qualcomm are major winners. Gemini is becoming the connective tissue across Samsung's devices."

— Paolo Pescatore, PP Foresight

India Pricing and Availability

Samsung opened pre-reservations for the Galaxy Z Fold 8 series in India ahead of the launch event. Indian pricing has not been officially confirmed, but based on European pricing, the Z Fold 8 Ultra is expected to start around ₹1,65,000-1,70,000, the Z Fold 8 around ₹1,45,000-1,50,000, and the Z Flip 8 near ₹95,000-1,00,000. Samsung typically announces India-specific pricing and availability within days of the global launch, with pre-order offers often including Galaxy Buds or trade-in credits. Shipping is expected to begin August 7 globally.
